items.title: MegazoneCloud Launches Its Amazon Quick Center of Excellence to Turn Enterprise Data Into Autonomous Action
items.summary: MegazoneCloud (CEO: Doug Yeum), a leading AI and cloud company, today announced the official launch of its Amazon Quick Center of Excellence (CoE). The dedicated delivery practice is built for the last mile of enterprise AI where most initiatives stall between a promising pilot and a governed production system people actually use. It directly addresses the defining question on every leadership agenda: how much work should run autonomously, and under whose oversight?
